name: direction
title: Direction
description: Plain re-export of shadcn's Direction provider (DirectionProvider and useDirection), with the same API. Nothing is dressed: direction has no manga effect. It always takes `direction` ("ltr" or "rtl"), which both the Base UI and the Radix versions accept. The writing direction (dir) is what the kit's logical properties and rtl: variants follow; the manga reading order (data-reading) is a separate setting.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/direction". It wraps your own components/ui/direction, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Left to right or right to left, for the whole subtree.
meta.usage:
import { DirectionProvider, useDirection } from "@/components/ui/manga/direction"
...

props.name: direction
props.description: The direction the subtree is laid out in. Set dir on the element too, so CSS follows.

props.name: useDirection()
props.description: Returns the current direction from the nearest provider.
